dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual, symmetrical narrowing of the visible lateral margins from the mid-body section toward the posterior peduncle.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Light-grey to off-white median pixel intensity across the dorsal surface.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Low-frequency, diffuse darker-grey clusters localized primarily along the central longitudinal axis.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse, low-contrast gradient slopes between the light-grey base and darker mottled areas.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: A distinct, high-contrast vertical linear mark is visible on the left side of the dorsal surface, oriented longitudinally.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A single, elongated vertical scar or rake mark is present on the left dorsal flank, running parallel to the central axis.
other_distinctive_markers: Visible elliptical blowhole aperture at the anterior end and a pronounced dorsal ridge extending toward the posterior.
